proposed_from.topic: For finite-population two-stage randomized saturation experiments, fix saturation-label count K, cluster-size bound b, rational treated-count table, and a rational direct/saturation contrast over bounded own-treatment-by-saturation potential outcomes. Allow arbitrary joint laws over saturation labels and feasible treated subsets and arbitrary measurable estimators. Prove endpoint completeness by an explicit multilinear extension, derive a polynomial-size rational convex primal/dual orbit game for fixed K,b with implementable optimal correlated design and nonlinear estimator, and extract rational epsilon-saddle certificates including all zero-probability faces. Prove uniform conditional subset randomization is without loss, give the finite primal-dual feasibility characterization of when optimized common-probability independent saturation is minimax, and prove a strict correlated-saturation advantage for the certified two-size-three-cluster instance and its infinite rational contrast neighborhood. Preserve the actual exact-count observation hypergraph rather than replacing it by a pairwise conflict graph, and do not claim an elementary closed-form equality classification, growing-cluster separation, or exact rational optimizers. The applied consumer is Baird--Bohren--McIntosh--Ozler's randomized-saturation design and its direct/spillover analysis. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Bernoulli lifting plus Jensen gives endpoint completeness for every fixed observation hypergraph; perspective-coordinate minimax duality and response/assignment/observation histograms give the orbit game; a rational 78-decision procedure and 17-orbit prior certify 1.3649753<R*<=1.364981422, while a 15-orbit prior proves R_ind>1.3659 for c=(3,-1,-1,-1), with the gap persisting for nearby rational contrasts. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Complete the polynomial Turing bit-complexity proof for orbit-kernel construction, conic weak optimization, rational epsilon-certificate extraction, and continuous-estimator decoding, including all zero-mass faces. EARLY KILL TEST: Independently reconstruct the orbit kernel for cluster sizes (3,3,4), compare selected response-histogram likelihoods and every assignment-orbit normalization with labeled enumeration, and rerun the saved rational certificate verifier; any mismatch stops K2 or the strict-comparison claim until resolved. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest all-procedure results are Hull2026, Theorem 1, and SudijonoDobribanTchetgenTchetgen2026, Theorems 2.2--2.3; both exploit a no-interference observation channel and conclude that independent assignment is minimax. The closest interference result is KandirosHarshawSavje2026, Proposition 2.2, whose pairwise conflict graph cannot encode the minimal forbidden triple created by an interior size-three exact-count saturation slice. The proposed kernel preserves that higher-order observation structure and remains exact for every feasible treated-count table, including boundary and label-constant menus; it admits correlated saturation actions and yields an exact finite conic equality rather than rate bounds. The rational witness then proves a strict reversal of the no-interference independence conclusion even after optimizing over every measurable estimator, and continuity promotes it from one hand-tuned contrast to an infinite rational neighborhood.

seed_details.seed: Exact endpoint observation-hypergraph orbit game for bounded randomized saturation experiments
seed_details.anchor: SudijonoDobribanTchetgenTchetgen2026, Theorems 2.2--2.3 and Appendix A; BairdBohrenMcIntoshOzler2018, Sections 2.2, 3.1, 4, and 5
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the no-interference scalar count reduction by a likelihood kernel on complete response, assignment, and observation-hypergraph orbits.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from bounded-outcome Bernoulli lifting and finite minimax duality in SudijonoDobribanTchetgenTchetgen2026.
seed_details.rebuttal: The lift supplies only endpoint completeness; exact-count interference requires a new non-pairwise kernel, stabilizer weights, correlated design actions, and total decoding.

seed_details.seed: Bit-certified polynomial orbit compiler with rational epsilon saddles and zero-face decoding
seed_details.anchor: Kallus2021, mixed-strategy design formulation and conclusion; prior proposal \(\texttt{exp\_multiarm\_secondorder\_minimax\_frontier}\), specialization \(v1\), technical limitation
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace existential group averaging and real-arithmetic conic optimization by canonical histogram enumeration with explicit rational stabilizer multiplicities and facial reduction.
seed_details.red_team: Routine application of polynomial-time second-order-cone programming once the finite game is written.
seed_details.rebuttal: The program itself must be built without labeled enumeration, its coefficients have growing bit length, and zero-mass perspectives require certified facial treatment and total estimator recovery.
seed_details.disposition: selected as the first-class open question

seed_details.seed: If-and-only-if independence frontier with a strict correlated-saturation neighborhood
seed_details.anchor: Hull2026, Theorem 1 and Appendix A.4; CaiPougetAbadieAiroldi2022, main bias-variance optimization
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Embed common-probability product label laws as a nonlinear image inside the correlated assignment-orbit simplex and test all correlated tangent directions with dual slack.
seed_details.red_team: Independent assignment must remain minimax by the no-interference tensorization in Hull2026.
seed_details.rebuttal: The exact-count observation hypergraph does not tensorize; exact rational priors certify a strict gap that persists on a rational contrast neighborhood.

seed_details.seed: Conditional uniform subset randomization without loss under arbitrary joint two-stage laws
seed_details.anchor: Prior proposal \(\texttt{exp\_saturation\_exacthit\_deficiency\_design}\), specialization \(v1\), exact-hit factorization lemma; Kallus2021, minimax symmetrization
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Average the entire design-estimator procedure, not only the assignment law, over within-cluster permutation groups.
seed_details.red_team: Uniformity is immediate because all subsets of a given size have equal cardinality.
seed_details.rebuttal: An arbitrary original law need not be uniform; the risk comparison requires transporting schedules and nonlinear estimators while preserving the full hypergraph.

seed_details.seed: Heterogeneous-size orbit game for both person- and cluster-weighted contrasts
seed_details.anchor: Prior proposal \(\texttt{exp\_saturation\_exacthit\_deficiency\_design}\), specialization \(v1\), equal-size limitation; BasseFeller2018, Sections 3.2, 4, and 6.3
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace one response alphabet by size-tagged cluster-type histograms and retain the person-level normalization in the target map.
seed_details.red_team: Unequal sizes are a mechanical relabeling of the equal-size game.
seed_details.rebuttal: Assignment multiplicities, observation alphabets, and person-versus-cluster estimand weights all change; the \((3,3,4)\) enumeration verifies the new normalization boundary.
seed_details.disposition: integrated into the general kernel rather than advertised separately

seed_details.seed: Non-representability of exact-count saturation by pairwise conflict graphs
seed_details.anchor: KandirosHarshawSavje2026, Proposition 2.2 and Appendix A.5; AronowSamii2017, Sections 3--5
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Test whether feasible simultaneous observations form the independence complex of a graph; the size-three exact-count slice fails by a minimal forbidden triple.
seed_details.red_team: A hypergraph can always be replaced by its two-section without changing optimization.
seed_details.rebuttal: The two-section admits a jointly impossible triple, changing endpoint likelihoods and hence the all-estimator minimax risk.

seed_details.seed: General exposure-mapping minimaxity under bounded automorphism-orbit complexity
seed_details.anchor: AronowSamii2017, Sections 3--6 and conclusion; BasseAiroldi2018 impossibility boundary
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace anonymous response histograms by automorphism orbits of an arbitrary assignment-to-exposure hypergraph and characterize when their number is polynomial.
seed_details.red_team: Bounded cluster size already makes every local exposure map finite, so the extension is automatic.
seed_details.rebuttal: Global exposure automorphisms can have exponentially many response and observation orbits even with bounded local neighborhoods.
seed_details.disposition: dropped after deep scan because no sharp orbit-complexity frontier is yet specified

seed_details.seed: Elementary structural classification of when independent saturation is minimax
seed_details.anchor: CaiPougetAbadieAiroldi2022; prior proposal \(\texttt{exp\_saturation\_exacthit\_canonical\_activeface\_certificate}\), specialization \(v1\), KKT theorem
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Eliminate the prior and estimator variables from the semialgebraic saddle system to obtain conditions only on \(r\) and \(c\).
seed_details.red_team: The finite feasibility system is already the classification.
seed_details.rebuttal: A coefficient-level classification would be stronger, but current evidence does not support quantifier elimination with an interpretable boundary.
seed_details.disposition: dropped because the evidence supports only the finite primal-dual criterion

seed_details.anchor: Hull2026, asymptotic discussion; SudijonoDobribanTchetgenTchetgen2026, second-order minimax expansion
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct a tensorization or subadditivity argument that preserves a strict correlation gap under increasing numbers of clusters.
seed_details.red_team: Replicate the two-cluster witness and average the estimators.
seed_details.rebuttal: Nonlinear minimax procedures may be biased, so naive replication neither tensorizes risk nor preserves the strict gap.
seed_details.disposition: dropped for lack of a valid amplification theorem

seed_details.seed: Design-based confidence sets for the decoded nonlinear minimax estimator
seed_details.anchor: JiangImaiMalani2023, Theorems 1--3 and Section 6; AronowSamii2017, Sections 5--6
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive a randomization limit for a biased nonlinear posterior rule whose active observation cells and design can change with the finite instance.
seed_details.red_team: Apply the two-stage central limit theorem and studentize.
seed_details.rebuttal: The decoded minimax rule is not an additive unbiased estimator, so published dependency central limit arguments do not apply directly.
seed_details.disposition: dropped to keep the proposal finite-sample and avoid assuming a nonexistent asymptotic linearization

proposed_from.literature_map: The application thread runs from HudgensHalloran2008's fixed-count two-stage direct and spillover estimands through BairdBohrenMcIntoshOzler2018's regression-power allocation problem, BasseFeller2018's unequal-size weighting, and JiangImaiMalani2023's unbiased randomization inference. The exposure thread is AronowSamii2017's exact design--exposure kernel. The minimax thread is Kallus2021 and Bai2023 on mixed designs and invariance, Hull2026 and SudijonoDobribanTchetgenTchetgen2026 on unrestricted nonlinear bounded-outcome procedures without interference, and KandirosHarshawSavje2026 on graph-based network minimax bounds. CaiPougetAbadieAiroldi2022 confirms that interference changes the preferred saturation distribution but fixes a model and estimator. No inspected source contains the exact size-tagged hypergraph orbit equality, the zero-face rational compiler, or the unrestricted correlated-versus-independent saddle frontier.
